contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A base sherd fragment from a Roman East Gaulish samian ware vessel dating to AD 160-200. The fabric is a buff orange colour and is fully oxidised. It is hard and exhibits frequent micaceous inclusions. The vessel has been coated in a dark orange slip which has been abraded in places. A partial maker's stamp []VSVSF[] is visible on the basal interior. This is the stamp of the potter Melausus V or…
